name: Azure Storage Integration
project_description: Azure Storage Integration provides a thin integration layer between Drupal and Microsoft Azure Storage. In this 2.0.x release the module centralises Azure account credentials (account name, protocol, endpoint suffix, and test/live account keys held as Key module entities) in a single admin settings form, and exposes one service, azure_storage.client, that builds an Azure Storage connection string and returns a configured Azure Queue service (MicrosoftAzure\Storage\Queue\QueueRestProxy) for sending and reading queue messages. Retrieve the service with \Drupal::service('azure_storage.client'), call getStorageQueueService() (or setStorageQueueService($connection_string) for a custom connection), then use the returned QueueRestProxy, e.g. $service->createMessage('queue_name', 'message'). The module also installs an azure_storage_file metadata table intended for future blob/file support, but this version ships no stream wrapper or blob file backend.
